preconditions.description: Attacker must hold sufficient tokens to trigger transfer and potentially meet swap threshold
swapAndLiquifyEnabled must be true and contract must hold enough tokens to trigger swap
Attacker controls a malicious contract that can receive tokens and reenter during swap operation

exploit_hint: 1. Deploy a malicious contract with a receive/transfer hook that can reenter the token contract. 2. Ensure the token contract has sufficient balance to trigger swapAndLiquify (>= numTokensSellToAddToLiquidity). 3. Call transfer() to send tokens to the malicious contract. 4. During the swapTokensForEth() external call to Uniswap router, the malicious contract reenters the transfer function. 5. Due to state updates occurring before external call completion, exploit the reentrancy to receive tokens multiple times or manipulate balance accounting. 6. Verify attacker token balance increased beyond expected amount after the exploit.
